shots.visual: A Smartphone screen displaying a live broadcast with millions of viewers. A terrified woman is crying on her knees on a luxury marble floor.

lines.speaker: zhao_meiling
lines.text: 求求你們別看了！我錯了！求求你陳峰！

shots.visual: A lavish living room filled with media reporters and legal officials surrounding the hysterical woman on the ground.
A sharp, cold-eyed man in a tailored dark suit looks down with absolute disgust and zero emotion.

lines.speaker: chen_feng
lines.text: 趙美玲，背叛我時，想過今天嗎？

shots.visual: A large projector screen displaying security footage from 5 years ago showing a younger woman signing fraudulent asset transfer papers.

lines.speaker: zhao_meiling
lines.text: 陳峰那個傻子，資產全是我們的了！

shots.visual: Reporters thrusting microphones towards the disheveled woman on the floor while camera flashes blind her.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: 趙美玲直播公開，涉嫌洗錢與誣告！

shots.visual: The woman's trembling face, her eyes filled with shock and horror as her reputation collapses completely.

lines.speaker: zhao_meiling
lines.text: 不……這不可能！影片哪來的？！

shots.visual: A calm, elegant assistant in a sleek navy suit steps forward holding sealed legal repossession documents.

lines.speaker: lin_su
lines.text: 法院強制執行令，你的財產全數查封。

shots.visual: A luxury smartphone screen displaying multiple urgent bank notifications stating all accounts froze.
The woman desperately scrambles across the floor to grab her scattered designer handbags and diamond jewelry.
An expensive Italian leather shoe forcefully steps down on the designer handbag she is reaching for.

lines.speaker: chen_feng
lines.text: 用我的血汗錢裝高貴，舒服嗎？

shots.visual: The broken woman collapses completely onto her knees, weeping bitterly and reaching up in desperation.

lines.speaker: zhao_meiling
lines.text: 陳峰！看在五年感情的份上，放過我吧！

shots.visual: The man's eyes glint with lethal coldness as his face hardens into a contemptuous sneer.

lines.speaker: chen_feng
lines.text: 五年感情？你親手把我送進監獄！

shots.visual: Over the man's shoulder, the woman crawls forward on her hands and knees, grabbing his pant leg.

lines.speaker: zhao_meiling
lines.text: 那是趙天豪指使我的！我是被逼的！

shots.visual: Inside a dim luxury VIP room, a middle-aged villain hurls his glass against the wall, shattering it in extreme fury.

lines.speaker: zhao_tianhao
lines.text: 賤人！竟然敢把責任全都推給我！

shots.visual: Veins pop on the angry man's forehead as he stares at the live video stream with intense malice.

lines.speaker: zhao_tianhao
lines.text: 陳峰……我要讓你跟你的人死無葬身之地！

shots.visual: Back in the living room, the woman clings tightly to the man's leg, her face smeared with ruined makeup.

lines.speaker: zhao_meiling
lines.text: 只要你原諒我，我做牛做馬都願意！

shots.visual: Fast scrolling live comment overlay showing millions mocking her: 'Deserved!', 'Evil woman is finished!'.
The man looks down at her with absolute indifference, his voice devoid of warmth.

lines.speaker: chen_feng
lines.text: 你不配。

shots.visual: The man coldly kicks his leg back, sending the crying woman sprawling onto the cold marble floor.

lines.speaker: chen_feng
lines.text: 髒了我的鞋。

shots.visual: Police officers step in from all sides to restrain the screaming woman lying on the floor.

lines.speaker: zhao_meiling
lines.text: 不——！我的人生全毀了！

shots.visual: Heavy steel handcuffs snap firmly onto the woman's wrists.
The woman is dragged out by officers, shrieking in hatred and helplessness as she looks back.

lines.speaker: zhao_meiling
lines.text: 陳峰！你這個魔鬼！

shots.visual: The man pulls out a crisp white handkerchief, wipes his shoes clean, and tosses it onto the ground.

lines.speaker: chen_feng
lines.text: 清理垃圾完成。

shots.visual: The female assistant walks up to the man, holding a high-security black folder stamped with confidential markings.

lines.speaker: lin_su
lines.text: 陳總，趙美玲已經徹底身敗名裂。

shots.visual: The man turns his sharp gaze toward the folder, his eyes narrowing.

lines.speaker: chen_feng
lines.text: 趙天豪那邊什麼反應？

shots.visual: The assistant opens the folder, presenting a top-secret document detailing an upcoming dark ambush.

lines.speaker: lin_su
lines.text: 趙天豪準備動用最後底牌了。

shots.visual: Extreme close-up of the man's dark, fierce eyes glowing with deadly intent as the frame freezes.

lines.speaker: chen_feng
lines.text: 那就讓他，萬劫不復。
